name: Twelve Permissions #02 — THE VERDICT
description: TO BE TOLD IT WAS HOLLOW AND KEEP GOING. Anthropic shipped a new model, so I handed it what I had built and asked what it thought. It told me the truth: the dots were dressing. No science underneath, no substance behind any of the claims I was making. Two weeks of work and a thing I was proud of, and it took about a minute to establish that it did not mean anything. I was shocked, and then I was discouraged, and then I told it to rebuild the whole thing properly. Evidence: The rebuild that followed is live at projectintuition.ai. Deterministic seal: every mark derives from sha256 of the canonical event record; re-run the public generator to verify.
